main.summary: Options that control durable publication recovery scheduling, leader identity, jitter, and terminal failure handling.

field.name: LeaderLockName
field.summary: Stable PostgreSQL advisory-lock name used to elect one recovery leader.

property.name: PollingInterval
property.summary: Delay between completed journal recovery scans by the elected leader.

property.name: LeaderRetryInterval
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum randomized delay before a follower retries acquiring recovery leadership.

property.name: InitialJitterMaximum
property.summary: Maximum random delay before the first recovery scan.

property.name: CycleJitterMaximum
property.summary: Maximum random delay added after each completed recovery scan.

property.name: CandidatePageSize
property.summary: Maximum number of lightweight recovery candidates fetched by each database query.

property.name: TerminalFailureThreshold
property.summary: Number of recorded recovery failures after which a journal is terminalized and retired.
